verdict.rationale: Fastmail's API is built on JMAP, whose docs say clients can POST a `methodCalls` array to run query, fetch and send in one HTTP request. That is batched execution of operations, a form of bulk programmatic action. However, the evidence never shows one call updating, moving or deleting many messages at once, and the Filters & Rules and Searching pages appear only as titles with no bulk-action content. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of multi-item bulk updates (e.g. mass move/delete/label by ID set or query), UI bulk-selection actions, documented limits on batch size, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can perform bulk operations across many items at once

citations.quote: POST a `methodCalls` array. Query, fetch, and send, all in one HTTP request.
A single HTTP roundtrip is often all that's required.
